info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Direct Debit Cancellation-spec
info.description: The Direct Debit Cancellation API allows businesses to efficiently manage the cancellation of direct debit transactions. This functionality is essential for ensuring accurate financial operations and improving customer service by enabling quick resolution of payment-related requests. Consumers of this API may include financial institutions, banking systems, and payment processors that require capabilities for handling cancellations. By integrating this API, users can streamline their operational workflows and enhance user satisfaction in managing direct debit agreements.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a direct debit request identified by a unique resource ID. It facilitates the management of direct debits, offering functionality to withdraw consent for future withdrawals.
